column3: “The faith and love proceeding” supplies an explicit connection with the preceding verse.
For you is rendered as “on our behalf.”
The might of His glory is rendered as “His glorious might.”
“The Son” specifies the relative pronoun; over specifies the relation to creation.
“God” and “His” specify the subject and possession of the fullness.
The second through Him is not repeated.
“Christ’s” specifies His; body of flesh is rendered as “physical body.”
In every creation is rendered as “to every creature.”
BSB’s “my” with “sufferings” matches the Textus Receptus (μου).
Fulfilling the word is rendered as “fully proclaim.”
